name: Hierarchical Clustering of Material Boundaries in LH Space
aliases: Automated TF Design using Hierarchical Clustering
Automatic TF Design using Clustering on LH Space
Clustering-based Method for Automatic Transfer Function Design

Transfer Function Design Based on LH Histogram
definition: A semi-automatic transfer function design framework that uses hierarchical clustering of material boundaries defined in the LH space (Local intensity, Histogram peak coordinates) to allow intuitive user interaction with cluster hierarchies without predefined thresholds.
